changes.text: 一克镭的市价是十万美元。而制备镭的方法，是她和丈夫皮埃尔·居里多年前毫无保留地公开的，镭工业正靠它发展起来、高价卖货。公开了方法的她，实验室里那点镭当时只用于为医院提取射气；后来为本书写引言的梅洛尼在美国发起募捐，希望借此让她把研究继续下去。这笔账书里两边都有记载：梅洛尼在引言里记下了市价和募捐，居里夫人自己在自传笔记里算过放弃的那笔财富。

A gram of radium then sold for one hundred thousand dollars. The process for preparing it had been published years earlier, without reserve, by Marie Curie and her husband Pierre Curie, and the radium industry was now thriving on that very process and selling its product at a high price. She had helped give the method away, yet the radium in her laboratory was used at that time only for extracting emanations for hospital use, and Meloney, who later wrote the book's introduction, set out to raise a subscription in America to enable her to go on with her work. The book records both sides of that account: Meloney's introduction notes the price and the subscription, and in her autobiographical notes Marie Curie reckons up the fortune she gave up.

后来有一次（书中未写年份），日内瓦方面来请皮埃尔：那里物质条件更好，还能过上近似乡居的宁静生活。按居里夫人的记述，这个决定很艰难，皮埃尔动了心。最后让他定下来不去的，是他们正对镭做的研究，他怕这样的变动打断它。此时，索邦为医科学生而设的P.C.N.物理教席正好空缺。他申请后，在一心想让他不必离开法国的庞加莱的影响下获聘；她则受托在塞夫尔的女子师范学校讲物理课。他们留在巴黎，收入增加了，工作却更难：皮埃尔要兼两处课，其中学生众多的P.C.N.教学让他非常疲惫。

At one point (the book gives no year), Geneva came calling for Pierre, offering material advantages and the opportunity of a life comparable in its tranquillity with that in the country. In Marie Curie's account the decision was a grave one, and Pierre was tempted. What finally settled it was the radium research itself, since he feared the interruption that such a change must involve. At this moment the chair of physics in the Sorbonne's P.C.N. course was vacant; this was the physics, chemistry and natural history curriculum compulsory for medical students. He applied, and was appointed through the influence of Henri Poincaré, who was anxious to free him from the necessity of quitting France. Marie Curie was given charge of the physics lectures at the Normal School for Girls at Sèvres. They stayed in Paris and their income increased, but working conditions grew harder: Pierre was doing double teaching, and the P.C.N., with its very large number of students, fatigued him greatly.
1902年，她从矿渣里制得十分之一克纯氯化镭，只呈现新元素镭的谱线，并第一次测定这种元素的原子量，数值远高于钡，镭的化学个体性就此确立。1907年她做了更精确的第二次测定，定为225.35——她写书时公认的数值是226；她还和德比埃尔纳把镭制成了金属态。她亲手从矿石里提取的镭，按皮埃尔的意愿全部给了实验室，总量超过一克元素镭。

In 1902 Marie Curie succeeded in preparing a decigramme of chloride of pure radium that gave only the spectrum of the new element, radium, and made a first determination of its atomic weight, a value much higher than that of barium. The chemical individuality of radium was completely established. In 1907 she made a second and more precise determination, as 225.35; the number accepted when she wrote was 226. She also succeeded, jointly with André Debierne, in obtaining radium in the state of metal. The total quantity she prepared and gave to the laboratory, in agreement with Pierre Curie's desire, amounted to more than a gramme of radium element.

dispositions.rationale: 原段末把全段的账都归给居里夫人本人“一项一项算过”。但市价和募捐出自梅洛尼的引言，居里夫人自己写的是放弃的财富。现改为分别归属：梅洛尼记下了市价和募捐，居里夫人在自传笔记里算过放弃的财富。中英同步修改。

evidence.quote: That week I learned that the market price of a gramme of radium was one hundred thousand dollars.
So it is a fortune which we have sacrificed in renouncing the exploitation of our discovery

dispositions.rationale: 证据没有给日内瓦邀请任何日期，也没有交代它与木棚工作的先后。现删去“这时/Then”所暗示的时间顺序，改为“后来有一次（书中未写年份）”。后文“此时”仍对应E21中的“At this moment”，予以保留。中英同步修改。

evidence.quote: This was a grave decision for us to make.
At this moment the Chair of Physics

dispositions.rationale: 原文的“now”指作者写书时（1923年版），不是今天。现把“今天公认226”改为“她写书时公认的数值是226”，避免把1923年的说法写成当下判断。中英同步修改，数字225.35与226保持一致。
